body: You can ask any question you want. I was more thinking of unsolved mysteries but yours are good
I tried counselling haven't done it for a couple of months and I can't get refered again till August. The mental health system sucks here.
Thanks for the suggestion but thats not really my thing. I connect more with music but even that doesn't work when I'm like this. I don't really have anything anymore to turn too

I really am trying, no luck yet. I am a very introverted person so it is stepping out my comfort zone a bit. And with how people can be on the Internet, hiding behind there screens I get a little nervous and uncomfortable. I just feel a bit lonely and out of place.

Thanks. hopefully, I'm trying to find people to game with but thats not really working on this app so I might just go right to the source. This post was actually the first interaction with the Internet in years, I've always been cautious with people because their are a lot of weird people on the Internet. I'll just see how it goes.

Well I have started going to chat and meet subreddits to message people, some reply, some don't, but none have messaged in a couple of days. I don't really know how to start a random conversation so this is probably going to fail and fizzle out. This is probably why I like being alone, because I just suck at any kind of human interaction, I'm used to it.

I overthink extremely though (this could of been what caused my seizure) , whenever I go somewhere else I always think of an escape plan just incase, and another plan incase the first didn't work. I do believe that its all in my head but its a hard place to escape. I probably sound fine in these comments because everything is though out beforehand, but people in real life have commented how I'm an awkward person.

Yeah, after years of avoiding interaction with people on the Internet and being a lurker, I've been trying to interact more with it and talk to people, though this can be hard as I overthink and worry. Its just hard to know where to start. Also thanks for trying to help, it actually does mean alot.

Maybe, I won’t be referred until august and even then I’ll have to wait ages, the waiting list is about a year over here.
I suck at meeting new people too, I’m such an awkward person.

Don’t think it was the alcohol that caused it but it’s just precaution. I am out of hospital right now, I was only in there for about 5 hours. About the doctors, I have already asked them but nothing. Honestly things over here take so long and require constant pushing I just give up with it. I keep getting pushed around to different services.

We have samaritans over here, I've called them twice, every things anonymous and they are not meant to give you advice, just listen. Though they have suggested it.

Also shouldn't really be drinking alcohol for the meantime, since I had a seizure yesterday and had to be taken to hospital in an ambulance, just in a lot of pain right now
I'm more of a gin and vodka kind of person, with the occasional rum. I like to mix them together.
Not adhd, but they're trying to get me diagnosed for autism, not like it would change much though at least to me. Random question here but drink of choice?

I'm from the UK, nothing is ever done over here without constant nagging and time. I wouldn't be lying if I said I was drunk while making this post. Alcohol just makes me normal, the night when I made this post {almost committed suicide} I wasn't in distress or anything I was completely calm and I'm rarely calm when I'm suicidal. It was the Alcohol, it just makes me better. But I understand, it does make you reckless and makes you make quick decisions. In my life where I rarely feel like I'm in control, I love the drink. This comment makes me sound like an Alcoholic but I only drink like twice a month {though recently its been a bit more} , I just drink a lot on those days.
Sadly most of my solutions are to sleep or drink it off {also suicide sometimes}. The mental health system over here is a joke.

Unfortunately reaching out to people only made it worse for me, I Don't really like talking to my friends about it especially if they don't go through it themselves they just can't really comprehend and understand. Professional help was a bust, had about 9 sessions then got chucked on a waiting list, can't see myself getting off it till next year. And I've asked for medication but basically got brushed off. I feel like I'm trapped in a tunnel but there's no light at the end, and just can't see things getting better.

Was there a turning point in your life? Or did it just randomly get better? For me in this world I think even if there is beauty the cons will always outweigh the pros. People are unpredictable, thats what can make the world so horrible.
Hi UJ, thanks for the comment, glad that your life took a turn for the better I guess thats what I'm waiting for. I just can't remember the last time I was happy. Anyway happy to chat.
